title: Adverb Position in Persian Sentences
summary: Ordering time and place adverbs correctly.
explanation: Time adverbs usually follow the subject, followed by place adverbs, object, and verb.
rules: Subject + Time Adverb + Place Adverb + Object + Verb

example_translations.ex_advp_1: I read a book at home yesterday.

common_error_explanations.err_advp_1: Place adverbs before the object and final verb.
